videos.headline: Kansas converts on 4th down, scores late to upset No. 6 Oklahoma
videos.description: Lawrence Arnold hauls in a big fourth-down reception, then Devin Neal scores the go-ahead touchdown to put Kansas ahead for good against Oklahoma.
